clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Runetotem appears outside Razor Hill in Durotar. The tauren spirit offers wisdom and a blessing to travelers who seek her.

Elder Runetotem appears beside Razor Hill, far from the grassy plains and sacred burial grounds of Mulgore. Her presence brings the ancient traditions of the Shu'halo to the Horde's home along the Great Sea.

During the Lunar Festival, spirits of great leaders, shamans, and heroes appear throughout the world to commune with the living. Elder Runetotem carries the name of a line that reveres the Earth Mother and seeks spiritual communion. Travelers who honor her receive ancestral tokens and her blessing.
